pension.value: HIGHEST-VALUE handoff for Charles: as a soldier who died of a service-contracted disease, his INVALID pension affidavits likely name the disease and document its onset in service — the evidentiary core of the family's 'died of war disease' tradition. A mother's/dependent claim may follow his 1875 death.
